name: llama.cpp Router
short_desc: Local uncensored LLM server (router mode) with on-demand load and idle unload
author: ggml-org
description: llama-server in router mode: several models declared in a preset file, loaded on the first request and unloaded after --sleep-idle-seconds. Exposes an OpenAI-compatible API consumed by LiteLLM. Ships with presets for two abliterated (uncensored) Qwen models: qwen (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, MoE with experts offloaded to RAM) and qwen-fast (Qwen3.5-4B, fully GPU-resident).

form_fields.label: Models directory (host path)
form_fields.hint: Absolute host path containing the GGUF files (e.g. /home/romain/models)

form_fields.label: Sleep idle seconds
form_fields.hint: Unload model after N seconds of inactivity (-1 disables)

form_fields.label: Max loaded models
form_fields.hint: Max models held simultaneously. Keep at 1 unless you have lots of memory.
